card.name: Leading digit of round hundreds
card.fires_on: A single leading digit (2, 3, 5, 1, 4) that is directly followed by "00" or "50", forming a number in the hundreds. It appears in doses, heart rates, weights, and counts.

modes.label: Hundreds in clinical values
modes.description: The first digit of a round hundred or half-hundred, given as a dose, lab cutoff, or rate.
modes.example: tachycardia with rates up to <<2>>00 beats/min., arrhythmias

modes.label: Hundreds in general text
modes.description: The first digit of a round hundred used for a count, age, or weight.
modes.example: Google says it ranks sites using more than <<2>>00 different signals.

card.writes: It promotes hundred-type tokens, so it prepares the model to finish the number as a hundred.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a number like 200 or 150, just before the model writes the rest of it.
